title: Friends
inviteNote: They get an email with your name and note. Once they accept, you can link them to a person and share with one tick.
noFriends: No friends yet. Invite someone by email.
intro: Friends belong to your account, not to a workspace. In each workspace you choose what a friend can see: a whole workspace through Members, or single events and tasks through Share.
searchHint: Search by username, full name, or email; the @ is optional. People who hide their email are not found by it.
noMatch: No one matches. Invite them below.
yourCodeNote: Anyone who scans it can send you a friend request. Nothing else is shown.
codeLabel: QR code of your profile link
linkNotCopied: The link could not be copied
